Description: Context condensation synchronous latency overhead
Root_Cause: Sequential regex and Ollama execution blocking event loop
Remediation_Strategy: Optimized regex heuristics and cached topic tracking in query condenser

Description: Evaluator defect & benchmark overfitting in test suite
Root_Cause: Evaluator checked exact 8 APIs hardcoded in premise verifier
Remediation_Strategy: Expanded 500-case diverse evaluation harness spanning novel APIs

Description: Pronoun tracking failure across multi-turn dialogs
Root_Cause: Condenser lost antecedent context after topic shifts
Remediation_Strategy: Added semantic entity resolution preserving prior curriculum topics

Description: Hardcoded API dictionary in premise verifier
Root_Cause: Static 8-method array only recognized hardcoded synthetic APIs
Remediation_Strategy: Dynamic syntax entity extraction pattern matching any fabricated API

Description: Limited regex patterns for premise contradiction
Root_Cause: Exact phrase match missing alternate phrasings
Remediation_Strategy: Evidence-grounded heuristic refutation asserting curriculum absence

Description: Calibrated abstention boundary cliff between 0.180 and 0.220
Root_Cause: Abstention gate hard cliff at 0.200 cosine similarity
Remediation_Strategy: Continuous composite confidence function weighting similarity, margin, and keyword ratio

Description: BM25 term frequency inflation on distractor keywords
Root_Cause: Linear term frequency accumulation allows repeated distractor words to dominate
Remediation_Strategy: Okapi BM25 sublinear query term saturation (k3=1.2) and dense deficit penalty

Description: LRU cache eviction churn on >5,000 unique embeddings
Root_Cause: In-memory LRU without persistent backing creates CPU spike under churn
Remediation_Strategy: Optimized bounded coordinator cache with fast key indexing

Description: Context condensation token length limits
Root_Cause: Unbounded history concatenation could overflow LLM context
Remediation_Strategy: Token-bounded history sliding window preserving system prompts

Description: Empty catch blocks swallowing DB errors in rag_service.php
Root_Cause: catch(Throwable $e) {} silently dropped DB insert failures and incremented indexed counter
Remediation_Strategy: Structured error logging via error_log() and atomic increment only on success
Before_Metric: Silent data loss masked with success
After_Metric: Explicit error logging and accurate chunk counts

Description: Correlation IDs not propagated to upstream Ollama requests
Root_Cause: CURL calls omitted X-Correlation-ID header, breaking distributed tracing
Remediation_Strategy: Added getCorrelationId() and forwarded X-Correlation-ID across all cURL requests

Description: Flat similarity margin and out-of-domain false acceptance
Root_Cause: High generic token overlap permitted off-topic queries to pass abstention
Remediation_Strategy: Multi-factor quality gate checking topSim, margin, and keyword coverage

Description: Prompt injection through nested XML tags
Root_Cause: Nested XML tags penetrated simple prompt framing
Remediation_Strategy: Strict system prompt role demarcation and instruction fences

Description: Upstream inference (Ollama) timeout without graceful degradation
Root_Cause: PHP blocked indefinitely on frozen Ollama without clean error response
Remediation_Strategy: Explicit CURLOPT_TIMEOUT (30s embed, 60s chat) with structured fallback JSON

Description: Non-deterministic chunk tie-breaking on RRF score ties
Root_Cause: Tied RRF scores resulted in random SQLite row order variance
Remediation_Strategy: Deterministic multi-tier tie-breaking: RRF -> Dense similarity -> Chunk ID

Description: Gateway-Worker duplicate embedding generation on conversational queries
Root_Cause: Gateway embedded raw pronoun query before PHP condensed and re-embedded it
Remediation_Strategy: Gateway inspects hasHistory; skips redundant raw embedding for conversational queries

Description: Multi-worker in-memory corpus desynchronization on CRUD mutations
Root_Cause: Independent PHP processes cached corpus in RAM; mutations only updated 1 worker
Remediation_Strategy: Monotonic corpus version file (rag_corpus_version.txt) with auto-reload on version bump

Description: TCP RST on payloads >= 1MB via req.destroy()
Root_Cause: Abrupt socket destruction caused client-side read ECONNRESET error
Remediation_Strategy: Socket stream draining via req.resume() returning clean HTTP 413 Payload Too Large

Description: Conversational memory recency latching (topic return blindness)
Root_Cause: Condenser attached most recent topic even when user asked about earlier topic
Remediation_Strategy: Semantic back-reference matching resolving pronouns to historic curriculum entities
Before_Metric: 0% accuracy returning to React after Postgres
After_Metric: 100% accuracy returning to React and Postgres

Description: Non-Latin Unicode numerals falsely rejected as NON_LEXICAL
Root_Cause: Regex /[a-zA-Z0-9]/ strictly rejected fullwidth and Arabic digits
Remediation_Strategy: Updated regex to /[a-zA-Z0-9\p{N}\p{L}]/u supporting full Unicode numerals
After_Metric: HTTP 200 OK with valid chunk retrieval

Description: Dot-product calculation without vector length equality assertions
Root_Cause: Mismatched dimensions emitted 256 PHP Undefined array key notices per chunk
Remediation_Strategy: Strict array type check and dimension count assertion before vector dot product
Before_Metric: 256 PHP notices per chunk / NaN score
After_Metric: 0 PHP notices; invalid dimensions skipped safely

Description: Keyword stuffing displacing valid chunks from Rank 1
Root_Cause: Adversary repeated curriculum terms 15 times to manipulate BM25 rankings
Remediation_Strategy: Okapi BM25 k3 saturation and dense deficit disagreement penalty
Before_Metric: React displaced by PostgreSQL at Rank 1

Description: False premise verifier overfitting / 30% sycophancy on novel APIs
Root_Cause: Hardcoded 8-API verifier hallucinated on novel APIs not in dictionary
Remediation_Strategy: Generic evidence-grounded false-premise refutation engine

Description: Second-crash worker black hole (missing exit listener)
Root_Cause: startWorker(port) omitted proc.on('exit'); second crash terminated worker forever
Remediation_Strategy: Authoritative supervisor with single spawnWorker(port) maintaining persistent exit/error listeners

Description: Active generation counter leak on aborted / destroyed streams
Root_Cause: req.destroy() skipped 'end' event, permanently leaking activeGenRequests
Remediation_Strategy: Idempotent finalizeRequest() attached to finish, close, req close, and error events
Before_Metric: Permanent generation slot lockout after 20 aborts

Description: Greedy worker starvation under sequential workload
Root_Cause: Strict < comparison in load balancing routed 100% of sequential traffic to Port 8001
Remediation_Strategy: Healthy-aware least-loaded selection with rotating round-robin tie-breaker
After_Metric: Even 16.7% distribution across all 6 fast workers

Description: Gateway missing /health and /ready telemetry probes
Root_Cause: GET /health and /ready returned HTTP 404 Not Found
Remediation_Strategy: Implemented /health and /ready endpoints exposing full worker lifecycle & queue metrics
After_Metric: HTTP 200 OK with comprehensive JSON telemetry

Description: Raw null bytes and ASCII control codes bypassing sanitization
Root_Cause: Null bytes (\x00) and control codes (\x01-\x08) passed unsanitized to SQLite/Ollama
Remediation_Strategy: Sanitization pass stripping null bytes and non-printable control characters
